Figure 12.15 Prevalance of Obesity among U.S. Adults by Race/
Ethnicity, 2003 to 2006
Between 2003 and 2006 the prevalence of obesity among adult males varied little 
by racial or ethnic group. Among adult females, non-Hispanic blacks had the highest 
prevalence of obesity and non-Hispanic whites had the lowest. Mexican-American 
females had a prevalence that was intermediate between the other two groups. 
Obesity is deﬁ ned as a BMI 30.0 kg/m2.
Data from the National Center for Health Statistics.
